First-layer vocabulary of a table

Source: R/results.R
soil_first_layer.Rd

With layer = "first" the API keeps only the first horizon(s) of each profile (of each selected component for SOTWIS and SOTER polygons) and adds the columns first_layer_status (surface, tie, not_surface, depth_missing; with view = "revised" also surface_within_5cm and first_mineral) and profile_markings (negative_depth_above, empty_row, depth_order_conflict, numbering_starts_at_<N>, numbering_gap). This returns the vocabulary the API reported for the read.

Usage

soil_first_layer(x)

Arguments

x

A soil_table read with layer = "first". Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

A list view, statuses (character), profile_markings (character); NULL when x was not read with layer = "first".

See also

Other results: soil_columns(), soil_flags(), soil_markings(), soil_metadata(), soil_revised_rules(), soil_table

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
x <- soil_observations(soil, datasets = "soter_profiles", layer = "first")
soil_first_layer(x)
table(x$first_layer_status)
} # }
